aboutText: East West Roofing has been serving Thomastown with premium roofing solutions. We specialise in the La Escandella Collection, known for its high-quality colours and finishes in the Australian market. Available in various profiles, our tiles are designed to suit your style, bringing a touch of Spanish flair to your home.
servicesText: At East West Roofing, we provide end-to-end roofing services including new installations, repairs, and maintenance. We use top-quality materials like La Escandella tiles to deliver durable and aesthetically pleasing results for Thomastown properties.

services.title: Roof Installation
services.desc: Expert installation of new roofs using premium terracotta and concrete tiles.

services.title: Tile Replacement
services.desc: Replace old or damaged tiles to restore your roof's appearance and functionality.

services.title: Roof Repairs
services.desc: Prompt repair services for leaks, cracks, and storm damage.
